verdict.rationale: Daytona has no automation or workflow object with its own version history. The closest match is snapshots: persistent, point-in-time captures of sandbox state (filesystem, packages, settings, and memory for VM sandboxes). Snapshots can be built from Dockerfiles and used to create new sandboxes, which gives an indirect way to version an environment and roll back to it. Missing for 10: versioning of automations themselves, any review/diff or approval workflow, an explicit rollback or restore-to-prior-version operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
